instruction: Use the opened OpenStudio application and its CLI/API automation interface to organize /home/user/Desktop/init.osm and save the updated model as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process OSM text outside the OpenStudio environment. The current model is a single-story art gallery divided into west, center, and east exhibition rooms. The architect wants controlled gallery daylight from the south and a higher, softer daylight band on the north to avoid direct sunlight on artwork. Preserve the three galleries, flat roof, and continuous exterior walls while adding south shading, north high windows, lighting loads, daylight controls, and illuminance maps for the exhibition spaces. Deliver only the updated OpenStudio model file; object handles, serialization order, and automatically generated metadata may vary naturally.
